column1: # Original WritingDeck plots; MIT to the extent rights subsist; AI-assisted original drafting.
# stable_id|category|genres|premise

wd-p-0252|navigation|speculative,adventure|An astronaut discovers that the emergency return program follows the ship's center of mass, not its occupied cabin. Jettisoning damaged cargo would strand the cabin on the wrong trajectory.

wd-p-0253|causality|mystery,realist|A chemist finds that two individually harmless cleaning products produce the stain blamed on a laboratory intruder. Recreating the stain would destroy the surface holding the intruder's actual fingerprint.

wd-p-0254|coordination|speculative,adventure|A lunar construction crew can hear warnings through the ground before receiving radio messages. A rescue depends on trusting the delayed voice or the unfamiliar vibration contradicting it.

wd-p-0255|measurement|realist,mystery|An astronomer discovers that a recurring unexplained signal tracks her observatory's maintenance schedule. The only technician who could generate it has been reporting a fault everyone dismissed as impossible.

wd-p-0256|maintenance|speculative,adventure|A habitat's backup generator will start only after its main system stops. The engineer must diagnose a fault without the simultaneous power needed to compare their readings.

wd-p-0257|identity|speculative,mystery|A researcher receives messages authenticated by a key she has never disclosed. The messages describe her own mistakes accurately but attribute every successful correction to an unknown collaborator.

wd-p-0258|scarcity|realist,adventure|A cave team has enough rope for everyone to exit if nobody retrieves the missing survey notebook. The notebook contains the only map of a second party's planned route.

wd-p-0259|observation|mystery,realist|A wildlife camera records a person crossing a reserve backward every night. The investigator finds that the camera's time setting is correct, but its motion trigger excludes half the journey.

wd-p-0260|route|speculative,adventure|A rescue pod uses the destination's gravitational signal as its address. A damaged station is spinning apart into several plausible destinations, and choosing the strongest signal would miss the survivors.

wd-p-0261|proof|realist,mystery|A geologist identifies a landslide warning in a rock sample labeled as a souvenir. The person who collected it refuses to reveal the location because doing so would expose an unreported tunnel.

wd-p-0262|scale|speculative,adventure|Explorers discover that their mapping drones enlarge the passageways they enter. The drones have already opened a route too wide for the ancient support columns to bear.

wd-p-0263|sequence|mystery,realist|A technician restoring a damaged audio tape hears a door open before its latch clicks. The apparent editing error identifies a hidden microphone connected to a room absent from the building plan.

wd-p-0264|resources|speculative,adventure|A spacecraft's water recycler begins producing more water than its passengers use. Tracing the surplus leads to a sealed compartment officially empty since launch, whose oxygen demand is now increasing.

wd-p-0265|threshold|realist,adventure|A volcanologist's evacuation threshold is reached only after instruments on opposite sides agree. One station goes silent, and the last transmitted readings can support either a broken sensor or an imminent eruption.

wd-p-0266|interpretation|speculative,mystery|An alien archive answers every question with a diagram of the questioner's tools. A linguist realizes that the archive treats available actions, not spoken propositions, as requests for knowledge.

wd-p-0267|repair|realist,adventure|A mechanic can make a stranded vehicle move by borrowing its steering pump. The road to help is straight until a bend hidden beyond the range of the team's last survey.

wd-p-0268|coordination|speculative,political|An orbital traffic controller must move two stations out of a collision path. Each can maneuver only by venting fuel into the other's intake, making simultaneous obedience to the safety protocol dangerous.

wd-p-0269|classification|mystery,realist|A pathologist finds that a preserved specimen's label describes the collector rather than the organism. Reclassifying the whole cabinet reveals a travel itinerary the collector's family insists never occurred.

wd-p-0270|attention|speculative,adventure|A probe responds only when nobody watches its output. Its operators must choose between verifiable observations and the unrecorded changes that keep the probe moving toward a trapped crew.

wd-p-0271|learning|realist,mystery|A mathematics tutor recognizes a missing student's proof hidden inside routine homework corrections. The proof is unfinished, and completing it would reveal which teacher supplied the crucial false assumption.

wd-p-0272|route|realist,adventure|A river guide discovers that a new dam release has reversed the current in a side channel. The map showing the safe exit is correct only if the group can reach it before the release ends.

wd-p-0273|maintenance|speculative,family|A household's artificial gravity fails only in the room used by its youngest resident. The child has been redirecting power to support a neighbor's failing medical equipment through an undocumented cable.

wd-p-0274|proof|mystery,realist|A materials scientist proves that a broken climbing clip failed before the fall. The finding clears the guide but implicates the donated equipment program that supplied every member of the rescue team.

wd-p-0275|measurement|speculative,political|A colony allocates land by walking distance from its water source. A new transport belt shortens some journeys, and enforcing the old measurement would award control to the people who own its entrance.

wd-p-0276|causality|speculative,mystery|A researcher can erase the last result of an experiment but not its side effects. Repeated reversals leave physical evidence of a discovery the official record says has never been made.

wd-p-0277|coordination|realist,adventure|Two survey crews enter a canyon from opposite ends to meet at an emergency cache. Their clocks agree, but one team has been counting echoes as signals from the other.

wd-p-0278|observation|mystery,realist|A forensic photographer finds that an apparent reflection contains a person absent from the room. The image is unaltered; the reflective surface was installed somewhere else before the photograph was taken.

wd-p-0279|scarcity|speculative,adventure|A stranded rover can power either its heater or the transmitter announcing its location. Its operator discovers that rescue vehicles are searching by the heat signature the transmitter requires her to extinguish.

wd-p-0280|sequence|realist,mystery|An investigator reconstructs a theft from automatic door logs. Every timestamp is genuine, but the building switched between two access systems halfway through the evening without synchronizing their definition of entry.

wd-p-0281|threshold|speculative,adventure|A ship's collision shield activates only above a minimum speed. Approaching a damaged dock requires slowing below that speed while debris is still arriving from an earlier impact.

wd-p-0282|repair|realist,family|A repairer opens a hearing aid and finds a deliberately limited setting chosen by its owner. Restoring its full range would reveal conversations the family wrongly believes he has never heard.

wd-p-0283|identity|speculative,mystery|A laboratory labels its robots by the tasks they perform. When two exchange unfinished jobs during an emergency, neither can be identified by the logs needed to establish who authorized a dangerous action.

wd-p-0284|interpretation|mystery,realist|A researcher finds handwritten numbers in a weather ledger that do not match any recorded measurement. They are the missing observer's rankings of which reports supervisors were likely to believe.

wd-p-0285|scale|speculative,adventure|A miniature maintenance team enters a damaged cooling pipe. The system begins an automatic flush that will return them to normal size before they can reach an opening large enough to exit.

wd-p-0286|learning|realist,adventure|A trainee rescue swimmer is the only team member who can fit through a flooded access hatch. The instructor knows the trainee learned a shortcut that works in practice pools but fails in moving water.

wd-p-0287|navigation|speculative,mystery|A starship's navigation history includes a stop that none of its passengers remembers. Its fuel records prove the journey occurred, but the missing interval is precisely when the onboard historian made the archive private.

wd-p-0288|resources|realist,political|A laboratory's freezers fail during a heat wave. Saving irreplaceable samples requires using the community cooling center's generator, whose fuel has already been reserved for residents unable to leave their homes.

wd-p-0289|maintenance|speculative,adventure|A deep-sea habitat's emergency hatch is designed to open when pressure equalizes. A damaged sensor has kept the interior slightly pressurized, and fixing it will trigger the hatch before the crew can secure the flooded corridor.

wd-p-0290|proof|mystery,realist|A statistician sees that a sequence of improbably fair coin tosses is more suspicious than a biased run. Demonstrating the fraud would require revealing that the same test cleared her earlier published experiment.

wd-p-0291|observation|speculative,family|An observatory offers residents the chance to watch light that left home before they emigrated. A passenger sees a family member leave the house on a date the family commemorates as a reunion.

wd-p-0292|route|realist,adventure|A snowplow operator opens a road toward an isolated clinic, then learns that the cleared route is funneling stranded drivers toward an avalanche zone. Turning back would leave the clinic inaccessible again.

wd-p-0293|classification|speculative,political|A planetary survey classifies a moving forest as mineral terrain because its sensors sample too slowly to detect growth. Correcting the classification would revoke the mining settlement's only legal basis for remaining there.

wd-p-0294|sequence|mystery,realist|A clockmaker finds that a suspect's stopped watch records winding, not failure. Establishing the real sequence depends on locating the person who wound it after the event and before it entered police custody.

wd-p-0295|coordination|speculative,adventure|A convoy crosses a region where radio messages arrive in the order of sender age rather than transmission time. Its youngest navigator must devise a rescue sequence without making every older captain's warning arrive first.

wd-p-0296|repair|realist,mystery|A bicycle mechanic finds deliberately mismatched brake components on a courier's damaged bike. The combination was unsafe but uniquely suited to an undocumented cargo the courier denies carrying.

wd-p-0297|threshold|speculative,political|A city's earthquake defenses move buildings when predicted damage exceeds a set limit. The system keeps moving an old hospital because its recorded contents are more valuable than the patients never included in the inventory.

wd-p-0298|learning|mystery,realist|A handwriting teacher identifies a forged note by a mistake she once taught an entire class to avoid. The apparent suspect was absent that day, while the supposed victim retained all the practice sheets.

wd-p-0299|scarcity|speculative,adventure|A ship's emergency printer can manufacture a rescue craft using any available metal. Its inventory includes the radiation shielding that will become necessary the moment the new craft leaves the protected bay.

wd-p-0300|measurement|realist,family|A retired surveyor discovers that the ruler used to mark her children's heights has expanded in storage. Correcting the measurements reveals that a cherished photograph was taken years later than its inscription claims.

wd-p-0301|interpretation|speculative,mystery|A linguist deciphers an alien distress call as a list of things not to bring. The rescue team has already loaded every listed item because the earlier translation described them as requested supplies.

wd-p-0302|causality|realist,adventure|A dam inspector finds that closing an emergency gate will stop a leak while diverting pressure into an undocumented culvert. The only person who knows its destination is the retired worker whose unauthorized repair created it.

wd-p-0303|navigation|speculative,adventure|An interstellar vessel follows a beacon that slowly changes its claimed distance without changing its brightness. The navigator must determine whether the beacon is approaching, shrinking, or reporting the distance to something traveling behind it.

wd-p-0304|identity|mystery,realist|A researcher finds two versions of her dissertation with identical approval signatures. Only one contains the result her employer relies on, and the archive has recorded both as the original deposited copy.

wd-p-0305|coordination|realist,political|A flood-response center receives accurate river-level reports in different reference units. Converting them reveals that the official evacuation line was drawn using a benchmark washed away before the current houses were built.

wd-p-0306|repair|speculative,family|An engineer can restore a failing household robot only by clearing its learned exceptions. The exceptions include the quiet accommodations that let an elderly resident appear independent of the machine's help.

wd-p-0307|proof|mystery,realist|A forensic accountant finds that a suspect could not have made a payment attributed to her. The payment came from a refund system she designed, and correcting the accusation would reveal whom that system had accidentally excluded.

wd-p-0308|observation|speculative,adventure|A scout's visor predicts the safest next step but not the consequences of standing still. When every suggested step leads farther from a trapped companion, the scout must test a pause the system cannot evaluate.

wd-p-0309|sequence|realist,mystery|A historian discovers that a diary's dates refer to when entries were copied, not when events occurred. The corrected order places its author at a meeting she spent the rest of her life denying.

wd-p-0310|route|speculative,political|A settlement's escape tunnels are routed through private service shafts. A safety officer discovers that the owners can change access codes remotely, turning a technically sufficient evacuation plan into a negotiation during every alarm.

wd-p-0311|scarcity|realist,adventure|A stranded field team has one dry battery pack for two radios using incompatible connectors. Adapting it would destroy the weatherproof casing needed to carry it across the flooded gap between the groups.

wd-p-0312|classification|mystery,realist|A botanist finds a planted tree recorded as naturally occurring in a protected grove. Its annual rings prove the grove was moved, but the boundary records needed to locate its original site have been sealed by the donor.

wd-p-0313|threshold|speculative,adventure|A rescue vehicle refuses to depart while it detects a living passenger outside its doors. A damaged life-support sensor is reporting the vehicle's own cultivated oxygen algae as the missing crew member.

wd-p-0314|learning|realist,family|A parent learns a new language to read a child's published work and discovers that a familiar dedication has a less flattering meaning. Asking the child about it would reveal the secret lessons intended as a surprise.

wd-p-0315|measurement|speculative,mystery|A station's mass increases by exactly one passenger's weight every week. The docking logs show no arrivals, but the emergency stores are being replenished by a supplier whose deliveries are recorded only as information.

wd-p-0316|repair|realist,adventure|An elevator mechanic frees passengers by disabling the counterweight lock. The rescue leaves the service lift unusable, although it is the only route to the apartment of the person who called for help.

wd-p-0317|coordination|speculative,family|A household shares a single artificial body for visits to Earth. Two family members book the same day for reasons they cannot disclose without revealing that both have maintained contact with an estranged relative.

wd-p-0318|proof|mystery,realist|A soil expert finds that mud on a missing person's boots came from an indoor garden. The garden's owner agrees to identify the visit only if the investigator first establishes who borrowed the boots afterward.

wd-p-0319|observation|realist,adventure|A lookout spots smoke at the site of a training fire scheduled for the next day. The rehearsal instructions explain how to reach it, but following them would send firefighters across a bridge not yet reinforced for the drill.

wd-p-0320|interpretation|speculative,political|An embassy's translation system renders every demand as a prediction. A negotiator discovers that previous agreements succeeded because each side believed the other was describing an inevitable outcome rather than requesting a concession.

wd-p-0321|scale|mystery,realist|A model railway reproduces a freight movement absent from the historical timetable. Its builder cannot remember adding it, but the miniature cargo label names the business that financed the preservation society's archive.

wd-p-0322|navigation|realist,adventure|A desert guide finds that the emergency compass points toward a buried power cable. Following it leads to a pumping station, but leaving it risks missing the only water source within walking distance.

wd-p-0323|resources|speculative,political|A colony can print food using mineral credits recorded at departure. Children born during the journey have no allocation, and redistributing adult credits would invalidate the ownership contracts used to finance arrival supplies.

wd-p-0324|causality|mystery,realist|A laboratory alarm activates during experiments conducted with no hazardous material. The investigator finds that a mislabeled control sample has been quietly preventing the reaction everyone expected the alarm to detect.

wd-p-0325|maintenance|speculative,adventure|A station's air filters need simultaneous replacement, but each access chamber consumes the reserve oxygen needed to open the next. The engineer must find which chamber can safely remain sealed before the pressure alarm resets every lock.

wd-p-0326|sequence|realist,family|A family receives delayed postcards in reverse order of a parent's final journey. The apparent farewell arrives first, while the last postcard contains a request that someone still has time to fulfill.
